issues.explanation: This は is the initial mora of the compound verb はい出す, not a topic particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge with the following segment as はい出す, lemma はい出す, reading はいだす, meaning "crawl out".

issues.explanation: It is incorrectly separated from はい出す.
This is the て-form stem of 耐える, so its contextual reading is たえ, not the dictionary-form reading たえる.
This is the stem before the passive auxiliary; its reading is すて, not すてる.
The surface auxiliary form is られ, not the dictionary form られる.
The inflected auxiliary surface form is いた, not いる.
吾輩 is a first-person pronoun/common lexical item, not a personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Use type word or pronoun, while retaining lemma 吾輩 and reading わがはい.

issues.explanation: The past auxiliary must be separated from the inflected form of ある.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into あっ (lemma ある, reading あっ) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: In 迎えに来る, 迎え is the stem/noun form read むかえ, not the dictionary-form reading むかえる.
This is the conditional form before ば, read なけ, not the dictionary-form reading なく.
The past auxiliary is grouped into the verb.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 思っ (lemma 思う, reading おもっ) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: The negative and past auxiliaries are grouped into the verb.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 来 (lemma 来る, reading こ), なかっ (lemma ない, reading なかっ, auxiliary), and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: This conjunctive form is read わたり, not わたる.
This conjunctive form is read くれ, not くれる.
空く meaning "become hungry" is read すく; its conjunctive form 空き is read すき.
寒く is the adverbial form meaning "coldly/being cold"; the sense "become cold" belongs to なった.
The past auxiliary is grouped into なる.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into なっ (lemma なる, reading なっ) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: This contains the verb 出る followed by the negative auxiliary ない, whose inflected form is なく.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 出 (lemma 出る, reading で) and なく (lemma ない, reading なく, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: This conjunctive form is read もとめ, not もとめる.
In 池を左に見る, を marks 池 as the object of 見る; it does not mean "with."
This stem before ながら is read み, not みる.
The past auxiliary is grouped into the verb.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 歩い (lemma 歩く, reading あるい) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: This inflected form is read くるしく, not the dictionary-form reading くるしい.
The past auxiliary is grouped into 壊れる.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 壊れ (lemma 壊れる, reading こわれ) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: The potential form and past auxiliary are grouped together.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 入り込め (lemma 入り込む, reading はいりこめ) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).

issues.explanation: The past auxiliary is grouped into だ.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into だっ (lemma だ, reading だっ, auxiliary) and た (lemma た, reading た, auxiliary).
